<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19002012" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/2/#v19002012" target="_blank">Psalm 2:12</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>A multitude is gathering</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">from ev’ry tribe and nation,</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">Collected by the Christ and his</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">anointed congregation.</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sp">God’s Kingdom has been brought to birth;</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sz">We pray his will be done on earth.</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sp">This hope is a gift of priceless worth,</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz">Giving joy and consolation.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sp">Praise our God, Jehovah; Praise his Son forever—</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sz">King of all kings and the Lord of lords.</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp">Now unitedly we bow to his rule</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">And praise him with one accord.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>We praise the Christ, our reigning King,</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sz">with sounds of jubilation.</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp">This Prince of Peace will be our Judge</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sz">and bring about salvation.</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sp">We see the joys that lie ahead:</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sz">An earth released from fear and dread;</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sp">The time for our Lord to raise the dead.</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sz">What a time for exultation!</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sp">Praise our God, Jehovah; Praise his Son forever—</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sz">King of all kings and the Lord of lords.</p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sp">Now unitedly we bow to his rule</p>
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 sz">And praise him with one accord.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p30" data-pid="30" class="p30 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19002006" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/2/#v19002006" target="_blank">Ps. 2:6;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19045001" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/45/#v19045001" target="_blank"> 45:1;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="23009006" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/isaiah/9/#v23009006" target="_blank"> Isa. 9:6;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="43006040" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/john/6/#v43006040" target="_blank"> John 6:40</a>.)</p>
</div>
